recommendations: Fix missing licenses: For at least one of the license identifiers provided by the 'SPDX-License-Identifier' tags, there is no corresponding license text file in the 'LICENSES' directory. For SPDX license identifiers, you can simply run 'reuse download --all' to get any missing ones. For custom licenses (starting with 'LicenseRef-'), you need to add these files yourself.

Fix missing copyright/licensing information: For one or more files, the tool cannot find copyright and/or licensing information. You typically do this by adding 'SPDX-FileCopyrightText' and 'SPDX-License-Identifier' tags to each file. The tutorial explains additional ways to do this: <https://reuse.software/tutorial/>
